purpose: Provider-neutral onboarding and student journey state model
transition_rules: ACCOUNT_PENDING -> AUTHENTICATED only after identity provider confirms account
AUTHENTICATED -> ROLE_PENDING when a relationship/role requires verification
AUTHENTICATED -> CONSENT_PENDING when no additional role verification is required
ROLE_PENDING -> CONSENT_PENDING only after server-side role/relationship verification
CONSENT_PENDING -> READY only after required service/privacy decisions are recorded
READY -> RCAS_IN_PROGRESS when an authenticated assessment session is created
RCAS_IN_PROGRESS -> ROUTED only after server-side submission/routing
ROUTED -> DEEP_MODULE only with server-verified entitlement where required
ROUTED or DEEP_MODULE -> GOLDEN_PATH_REVIEW only with human-review workflow
GOLDEN_PATH_REVIEW -> BAHAR_ACTIVE only with appropriate continuity entitlement
invariant_rules: Browser state never grants a role
Browser redirect never grants a paid entitlement
Private data is never required before authentication and purpose are established
Consent types remain independent and versioned
Student evidence and professional interpretation remain distinguishable
No total talent score is required to advance the journey
